In modern scholarship, André Bareau includes the narrative under the title *Ayoghara-Cariyam* in his comparative examination of the canonical stories of the *Cariyāpiṭaka* and their corresponding *Jātaka* tales [Bareau].
SuttaCentral records no cross-canonical or external parallels for this text [SuttaCentral].
